title: CASEL: Consequence-Aware Selective Execution for Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.36570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using language agents increasingly modify external systems, yet most runtime safeguards allocate scrutiny by generic uncertainty scores or coarse mutation heuristics. We introduce CASEL (Consequence-Aware Selective Execution Layer), a model-agnostic runtime allocation policy that combines calibrated failure probability, state-dependent consequence, reversibility, ambiguity, and evidence freshness to choose, for each proposed tool call, among direct execution, verification, sandboxing, clarification, approval, and abstention by minimizing a per-mode cost. We formalize direct execution as selective prediction and state and test the validity conditions of a finite-sample threshold and a trajectory risk ledger. translated_title: CASEL：面向可靠长时程工具使用智能体的后果感知选择性执行
translated_abstract: 使用工具的语言智能体越来越多地修改外部系统，然而大多数运行时安全防护机制仅根据通用的不确定性评分或粗略的变更启发式方法来分配审查力度。我们提出了CASEL（后果感知选择性执行层），这是一种与模型无关的运行时分配策略，它综合了校准后的失败概率、状态相关的后果严重性、可逆性、模糊性和证据新鲜度，通过最小化每种模式的成本，为每个提议的工具调用在直接执行、验证、沙箱隔离、澄清、人工审批和拒绝执行之间做出选择。我们将直接执行形式化为选择性预测，并陈述和检验了有限样本阈值与轨迹风险账本的有效性条件。在一个包含20个随机种子、每个种子12万个测试动作的受控仿真实验中（其中每种方法拥有相同的干预菜单和相同的计算成本），CASEL将有害副作用轨迹的比例从无防护基线的14.75%降低至……（原文截断）
tldr: CASEL提出了一种与模型无关的运行时分配策略，通过综合失败概率、后果严重性、可逆性、模糊性和证据新鲜度等因素，为智能体的每次工具调用智能选择直接执行、验证、沙箱、澄清、审批或拒绝执行，显著减少了长时程工具使用智能体造成有害副作用的风险。
en_tdlr: CASEL introduces a model-agnostic runtime allocation policy that selects among direct execution, verification, sandboxing, clarification, approval, or abstention for each tool call by weighing calibrated failure probability, state-dependent consequences, reversibility, ambiguity, and evidence freshness, substantially reducing harmful side-effect trajectories in long-horizon tool-using agents.
